properties.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 21 at 10:17AM MST until October 21 at 10:45AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
SVRFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Yavapai County in west central Arizona...

* Until 1045 AM MST.

* At 1017 AM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located 7 miles northwest
of Williamson Valley, or 11 miles west of Chino Valley, moving
northeast at 45 mph.

HAZARD...Quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Damage to vehicles is expected.

* Locations impacted include...
Williamson Valley and Paulden.

This includes State Route 89 between mile markers 334 and 341.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing large hail.

A Tornado Watch remains in effect until 600 PM MST Wednesday for a
portion of west central Arizona.

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued October 21 at 7:33AM PDT until October 21 at 7:30PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Santa Barbara County in southwestern California...
Northwestern Ventura County in southwestern California...

* WHEN...Until 730 PM PDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 732 AM PDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This  will cause urban and small stream flooding.
- Rain rates between 0.50 and 1.00 inches per hour are possible
today and tonight.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Santa Barbara, Santa Ynez, Montecito, Point Conception,
Carpinteria, Solvang, El Capitan State Beach, Refugio State
Beach, Highway 101 through Gaviota State Park, Summerland,
Goleta, Sisquoc, Figueroa Mountain, Lake Cachuma, Highway 154
over San Marcos Pass, Big Pine Mountain, Santa Barbara Airport,
Mission Canyon and Hope Ranch.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued October 21 at 9:34AM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Volusia and Lake Counties.

.Persistent northeast winds have caused river levels on the St Johns
at Astor to rise into Moderate Flood Stage. The river is forecast to
climb slowly through Moderate Flood Stage through the end of this
week. There is potential for levels to approach Major Flood Stage
next week after northeasterly winds increase again.

For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 3.5 feet, Canals have overflowed into yards. Homes on
or near Wildhog and Bonnet roads become inaccessible with several
inches of water inside homes along the river and canals. Docks at
Astor Bridge marina and throughout Astor are completely submerged.
Bartram Rd and Holiday Circle are inaccessible with yards
completely submerged. Clair Street is inaccessible. Roads flooded
in South Moon Fish Camp, docks and yards at condominiums on Juno
Trail and water breaches the sea wall at Blair's Jungle Den.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 AM EDT Wednesday the stage was 3.1 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 8:30 AM EDT Wednesday was 3.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to remain steady above flood
stage at 3.2 feet.
- Flood stage is 2.3 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 945 PM EDT.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued October 21 at 8:32AM EDT by NWS Jacksonville FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Georgia...

Satilla River At Atkinson affecting Brantley County.

Additional information is available at
https://water.weather.gov/wfo/JAX

The next statement will be issued Thursday morning at 845 AM EDT.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Satilla River at Atkinson.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 13.0 feet, Warners Landing, Louis Landing and
secondary roads around KOA campgrounds begin to flood. At 14.0
feet, River Rock Road begins to experience flooding across the
road.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:45 AM EDT Wednesday the stage was 14.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall to 13.5 feet Saturday
morning.
- Flood stage is 13.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
